label: AnAge: The Animal Ageing and Longevity Database, Build 15 (3 July 2023)
bibliographic_citation: Tacutu R, Craig T, Budovsky A, Wuttke D, Lehmann G, Taranukha D, Costa J, Fraifeld VE, de Magalhães JP (2013) Human Ageing Genomic Resources: Integrated databases and tools for the biology and genetics of ageing. Nucleic Acids Research 41(D1):D1027–D1033.
license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (per HAGR terms of use)
measurement_technique: Literature-compiled life-history and ageing traits per species (maturity, gestation/incubation, clutch size, adult weight, maximum longevity, metabolic rate) with data-quality grades.
role: maximum longevity, body mass and reproductive life-history traits for the listed taxa (rows matched on Genus + Species, or on Genus for genus-rank taxa, or Family for family-rank taxa)

counts.description: data rows in anage_data.txt inside dataset.zip (release notes state 4,671 entries)
